Title: Global Navigation: Top menu links overlap horizontally making them unreadable
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in to the clone application. 2. Observe the top navigation header menu.
Expected Behavior: Navigation items (Home, Agreements, Templates, Reports, Admin) should have adequate horizontal padding and be clearly separated.
Actual Behavior: The text for the navigation items is mashed together and overlapping, causing severe UI breakage on a core screen.
Notes / Hypothesis: Missing flexbox spacing, gap, or padding CSS properties on the header navigation container.

Title: Dashboard: Primary action button text overlaps horizontally
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in. 2. Look at the primary action buttons (Send with AI, Get Signatures, etc.) on the main dashboard view.
Expected Behavior: Buttons should be spaced evenly with no text overlap, matching the original DocuSign layout.
Actual Behavior: The text and icons for 'Get Signatures', 'Sign a Document', 'Send with AI', and 'Use Envelope template' overlap heavily, creating an ugly pixel issue on a primary screen.
Notes / Hypothesis: Likely a missing margin/gap on the button wrapper or absolute positioning error.
